headline: VXL Instruments Q2FY27 loss narrows to ₹1.13 lakh
summary: VXL Instruments Ltd reported a standalone net loss of ₹1.13 lakh for Q2FY27, narrowing from ₹7.07 lakh in Q1FY27. The company remains under CIRP with zero operational revenue.

headline: Sai Life Sciences Q2FY27 PAT up 16% YoY
summary: Sai Life Sciences reported a 15.8% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹983 million for Q2FY27, driven by 22.5% revenue growth. Board also approved three senior management appointments.

headline: GTT Data Q2FY27: Loss narrows, revenue surges
summary: GTT Data Solutions reports a narrower net loss of ₹52.83 lakh in Q2FY27 as standalone revenue jumps 184% YoY. Board approves subsidiary acquisition in Hungary.

headline: Modi Naturals Q2FY27: Net profit up 9% YoY
summary: Modi Naturals reported a 9.45% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹1,102.42 lakh for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations grew 38.94% YoY to ₹20,489.95 lakh.

headline: Prime Focus subsidiary buys 2.41% in Anima Kitchent
summary: Double Negative Films, an indirect subsidiary of Prime Focus, acquired 2.41% equity in Spanish animation studio Anima Kitchent for ₹33.05 crore.

headline: Suvidhaa Infoserve Q2FY27: Loss narrows, revenue up
summary: Suvidhaa Infoserve Q2FY27 consolidated loss narrows to ₹11.3 crore as revenue rises 32% YoY. Standalone operations remain loss-making with minimal income.

headline: Maple Infra Trust RTA KFin shifts office address
summary: KFin Technologies, the Registrar and Transfer Agent for Maple Infrastructure Trust, will change its corporate office address effective December 1, 2026. Stakeholders must update correspondence details accordingly.

headline: Vikran Engineering Q2FY27: PAT up 72% in H1
summary: Vikran Engineering reported a 72% YoY rise in H1FY27 PAT to ₹25.38 crore. Revenue grew 27% to ₹424.1 crore, while the order book stands at ₹6,257 crore.

headline: Cello World Q2FY27 PAT falls 10% YoY
summary: Cello World reported a 10.3% YoY decline in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹81.9 crore despite 7.8% revenue growth, as EBITDA margins contracted due to elevated input costs.

headline: Texmaco Infra board authorizes KMPs for Reg 30 disclosures
summary: Texmaco Infrastructure & Holdings Limited's Board authorized its Managing Director, CFO, and Company Secretary to determine materiality of events for SEBI Regulation 30 disclosures.

headline: Persistent Systems allots ₹600 crore CPs
summary: Persistent Systems Limited allotted commercial papers worth ₹600 crore on November 5, 2026. The instruments carry a yield of 8.75% and mature in one year.

headline: IIFL Finance board to meet Nov 10 on fund raise
summary: IIFL Finance Limited board will convene on November 10, 2026, to consider raising funds via debt, rights, or preferential issues to support growth plans.

headline: Mufin Green Finance to host investor meet on Nov 10
summary: Mufin Green Finance Limited announced a virtual analyst and institutional investor meeting scheduled for November 10, 2026, at 12:30 pm IST.

headline: Hubtown Q2FY27 Revenue Jumps 127% YoY
summary: Hubtown reports Q2FY27 revenue of ₹4,730 Mn, up 127% YoY. Net profit at ₹231.6 Mn. Corporate restructuring schemes pending NCLT approval.

headline: Mphasis Q2FY27 PAT up 19.6% YoY to ₹5,611 crore
summary: Mphasis reported strong Q2FY27 results with revenue growing 17.4% YoY to ₹45,809 crore and PAT rising 19.6% YoY to ₹5,611 crore.

headline: Mphasis board amends UPSI disclosure code
summary: Mphasis Ltd board approved amendments to the Code of Practices for Fair Disclosure of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information on November 5, 2026.

headline: Runwal Enterprises submits SEBI fair disclosure code
summary: Runwal Enterprises Limited submitted its Code of Practices for Fair Disclosure of UPSI to stock exchanges, effective from listing date.

headline: Ravindra Energy secures ₹100 crore term loan from Tata Capital
summary: Ravindra Energy Limited has executed a ₹100 crore Rupee Term Loan agreement with Tata Capital Limited. The funds are earmarked for infusion into its jointly controlled entity, Energy In Motion Limited.

headline: Manappuram Finance sets Q2FY27 earnings call for Nov 12
summary: Manappuram Finance Limited will host its Q2 FY26-27 investor earnings call on November 12, 2026. Management will discuss results and business outlook via virtual meeting.

headline: Prozone Realty posts ₹566 crore net profit in Q2FY27
summary: Prozone Realty reported a net profit of ₹56,643.92 lakh for Q2FY27, driven by a ₹61,514.49 lakh exceptional gain from divesting mall subsidiaries to Inorbit Malls.
